description: The balance of a public Bitcoin, Ethereum or Solana address, read from blockchain.info, a public Ethereum RPC node or the Solana mainnet RPC, or a newly generated key pair. A generated private key is sent once and not stored, but it has passed through this service, so use it for tests and small amounts only. No API key, no account and no sign up: call it directly.
name: crypto_wallet
title: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana wallets
